| # Standard RIDs {#standard-rids-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                               |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the implementation of the standard RIDs which are used in the BODAS-service.

 

1\. Standard RID that is used by the BODAS-service for Saving all the parameters to NVM.

Required RID with RoutineControl(0x31):

  -------- ------------------------------ ------------- --------------------- --------------------------------
  RID      Sub-function                   Size (Byte)   Format of data sent   Meaning
  0xF000   0x01 (startRoutine)            1             uint8                 Save all the parameters to NVM
  0xF000   0x02 (stopRoutine)             1             uint8                 reserved not yet used
  0xF000   0x03 (requestRoutineResults)   1             uint8                 reserved not yet used
  -------- ------------------------------ ------------- --------------------- --------------------------------

 

2\. Standard RID that is used by the BODAS-service for Setting all the parameters to Default Values.

  -------- ------------------------------ ------------- --------------------- --------------------------------------------
  RID      Sub-function                   Size (Byte)   Format of data sent   Meaning
  0xF001   0x01 (startRoutine)            1             uint8                 Set all the parameters with default values
  0xF001   0x02 (stopRoutine)             1             uint8                 reserved not yet used
  0xF001   0x03 (requestRoutineResults)   1             uint8                 reserved not yet used
  -------- ------------------------------ ------------- --------------------- --------------------------------------------

## Integration of Routine Control Callbacks in ASW: {#integration-of-routine-control-callbacks-in-asw .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The BSW supports three callbacks each for the implementation of the following:

- saving all the parameters to NVM.

- setting all the parameters to default values.

The UDS callbacks with empty function definition will be generated in the \"bds_diag_appl_adapt.c\" file as part of the easyConfig build downloadable. These callbacks need to be integrated in the ASW build.

1.Saving all the parameters to NVM

- Callback for Start Routine : uint8 bds_uds_startRoutine_savePrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

- Callback for Stop Routine : uint8 bds_uds_stopRoutine_savePrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

- Callback for Request Routine Results : uint8 bds_uds_requestResults_savePrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

 

/\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

\* Callback Function bds_uds_startRoutine_savePrm()(RID : 0xF000)

\*

\* PARAM IN: \*dataIn1             : Data pointer where routine control option (Input) is available.

\* PARAM INOUT:OpStatus           : 0x00 :Indicates the initial call to the operation(At first UDS will call with Initial Call).\
\*                                : 0x01 :Indicates that a pending return has been done on the previous call of the operation\
\*                                        the operation will be called again with status(Dcm_OpStatusType) 2(pending) until return value is E_OK.

\*                                : 0x02 :Indicates the UDS request for cancel pending operation.\
\*                                : 0x03 :Indicate confirm a response pending transmission the operation will be called again with Dcm_OpStatusType as 3.      

\*

\* PARAM OUT:  \*dataOut1          : Data pointer where routine status record (output) is available.

\* PARAM OUT:  \*ErrorCode         : Data pointer to hold the NRC value (For the allowed NRC of the executed Service ID please refer to the

\*                                  specification of the service in ISO14229-1 (UDS)).

 

\* Return Values                  : 0x00 :Function call is valid, Positive Response.

\*                                  0x01 :Function call is invalid, Negative Response with NRC = 0x22(conditionsNotCorrect).

\*                                  0x0A :Function call still needs more time to be completed, NRC = 0x78(requestCorrectlyReceived-ResponsePending).

/\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*/

uint8 bds_uds_startRoutine_savePrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus,uint8 \* dataOut1,uint8 \* ErrorCode)

{

 

 uint8 return_u8 = E_OK;

 

 PARAM_UNUSED(dataIn1);

 PARAM_UNUSED(OpStatus);

 PARAM_UNUSED(dataOut1);

 PARAM_UNUSED(ErrorCode);

 

 /\* Application Specific function call for saving all the parameters to NVM \*/

 return_u8 = PrmMgr_SaveNvmAll();

 

 return (0u == return_u8)? E_OK: E_NOT_OK;

 

}

### 1.1   Request and Response {#request-and-response .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- UDS Request message for Saving all the parameters to NVM

  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------
  Service ID   Sub Function ID   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Control Byte 1
  0x31         0x01              0xF0                      0x00                        0x00
  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------

 

- UDS Response (Positive response)

  --------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------
  Response ID for Routine Control   Routine Control Type   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Status Byte 1
  0x71                              0x01                   0xF0                      0x00                        0x00
  --------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------

 

2.Setting all the parameters to default values

- Callback for Start Routine : uint8 bds_uds_startRoutine_setDefValsPrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

- Callback for Stop Routine : uint8 bds_uds_stopRoutine_setDefValsPrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

- Callback for Request Routine Results : uint8 bds_uds_requestResults_setDefValsPrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus, uint8 \* dataOut1, uint8 \* ErrorCode);

/\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

\* Callback Function bds_uds_startRoutine_setDefValsPrm()(RID : 0xF001)

\*

\* PARAM IN: \*dataIn1             : Data pointer where routine control option (Input) is available.

\* PARAM INOUT:OpStatus           : 0x00 :Indicates the initial call to the operation(At first UDS will call with Initial Call).\
\*                                : 0x01 :Indicates that a pending return has been done on the previous call of the operation\
\*                                        the operation will be called again with status(Dcm_OpStatusType) 2(pending) until return value is E_OK.

\*                                : 0x02 :Indicates the UDS request for cancel pending operation.\
\*                                : 0x03 :Indicate confirm a response pending transmission the operation will be called again with Dcm_OpStatusType as 3.      

\*

\* PARAM OUT:  \*dataOut1          : Data pointer where routine status record (output) is available.

\* PARAM OUT:  \*ErrorCode         : Data pointer to hold the NRC value (For the allowed NRC of the executed Service ID please refer to the

\*                                  specification of the service in ISO14229-1 (UDS)).

 

\* Return Values                  : 0x00 :Function call is valid, Positive Response.

\*                                  0x01 :Function call is invalid, Negative Response with NRC = 0x22(conditionsNotCorrect).

\*                                  0x0A :Function call still needs more time to be completed, NRC = 0x78(requestCorrectlyReceived-ResponsePending).

/\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*/

uint8 bds_uds_startRoutine_setDefValsPrm(uint8 dataIn1,uint8 OpStatus,uint8 \* dataOut1,uint8 \* ErrorCode)

{

 

 uint8 return_u8 = E_OK;

 

 PARAM_UNUSED(dataIn1);

 PARAM_UNUSED(OpStatus);

 PARAM_UNUSED(dataOut1);

 PARAM_UNUSED(ErrorCode);

 

 /\* Application Specific function call for setting all the parameters to default values \*/

 return_u8 = UdsPrmsDefaultVals_u8();

 

 return (0u == return_u8)? E_OK: E_NOT_OK;

}

### 2.1   Request and Response {#request-and-response-1 .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- UDS Request message for Setting all the parameters to default values

  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------
  Service ID   Sub Function ID   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Control Byte 1
  0x31         0x01              0xF0                      0x01                        0x00
  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------

 

- UDS Response (Positive response)

  --------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------
  Response ID for Routine Control   Routine Control Type   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Status Byte 1
  0x71                              0x01                   0xF0                      0x01                        0x00
  --------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------
